Replay

Claimball native host migration

2 min readOdin × GodotPage source ↓
On this page ↓
Run the acceptance fixtureConfigured Room contract

Claimball can run through Replay's existing authenticated Room lifecycle. A trusted connected player receives complete authority checkpoints and can become host after planned handoff or loss of the current host. Clients continue predicting their local avatar and the ball. The checkpoint is the complete authority world, including remote players excluded from each client's prediction group.

The fixed-coordinator entry point below remains useful for development. Party menus and browser RTC provide a provisioned Room path and durable publication as well. Whole-party restore has native WSS/browser acceptance through that path. Public deployment, Steam and broader recovery still require further acceptance. Ordinary Solo/Host/Join/Watch launches with RCB_COORD_PORT=0 keep the standalone session path and native file-save behavior.

Run the acceptance fixture#

Shell
REPLAY_CLAIMBALL_MIGRATION_OUT=/absolute/fresh/output nix develop --command bash tests/replay_claimball_migration/run.sh

It builds isolated app/coordinator projects and runs three native players through planned and abrupt-loss migration. RCB_MIGRATION_RENDER=1 renders the players and retains playing/recovering/recovered screenshots. The fixture owns all its processes and kills only the original owner in the crash case.

For an already prepared build, tests/replay_claimball_migration/execute.py takes APP_OUTPUT COORDINATOR_OUTPUT FRESH_RESULTS [planned|crash ...].

Configured Room contract#

  • RCB_COORD_PORT selects the local coordinator port. This initial adapter uses loopback and room 50, with Claimball content C3.
  • RCB_MEMBER, RCB_INCARNATION and the 64-character lowercase hex RCB_COORD_KEY provide the authenticated process identity. The development fixture provisions members 1–3, incarnations 101–103, with fixed test credentials.
  • RCB_TOKEN must match that member's admitted game identity. Fixture tokens are migration-1, migration-2 and migration-3. RCB_ROLE=host boots member 1; members 2/3 use client. The coordinator determines the actual owner/endpoints.
  • The fixture trusts members 1/2 to host and receive complete checkpoints. Member 3 is a normal player without that trust. Automatic nomination selects an eligible connected successor from the authenticated roster.
  • Hand off host is enabled for a hosting authority with a nominated successor. During recovery, the match stays visible with a status message. Restored clients keep their seats; the app clears old claims/smoothing/effects at the new epoch.
  • Direct file save/resume is disabled for configured Rooms. The app does not bypass Room fencing or policy by reopening a standalone checkpoint.

These fixed credentials and loopback endpoints are for local development. Use a proper admission/provider integration for deployed games. A configured Room is not an internet discovery or NAT-traversal service.

Set RCB_PROBE=1 for test-only prepared-checkpoint decoding and restore diagnostics. Normal play does not perform that extra decode. recovery_probe reports actual Room state and retained checkpoint equality; it does not install a test world or grant authority. The receipts state the measured rollback and scope of these native checks.
